This is the first record of your coins in the public journal of the Montana network (GENESIS). It can never be cancelled or deleted. It will announce the %1$s %2$s of your book. After it this phone itself records the coins you mint (MINT) and accepts the coins sent to you (RECV). Without an open chain coins can be neither sent nor received.

This is the first record of your coins in the public journal of the Montana network (GENESIS). It can never be cancelled or deleted. It opens the chain with zero: the coins of your book (%1$s %2$s) are confirmed in it by minting records (MINT), step by step, within the time of your key. After it this phone itself records the coins you mint and accepts the coins sent to you (RECV). Without an open chain coins can be neither sent nor received.
